tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (17.4:1).

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Used as background on `.data-table thead`, `.data-table tbody tr:hover`, `.button-secondary:hover`.

tokens.name: color-text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.card-meta`, `.footer-bottom`. 2.8:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-primary
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.nav-link:hover`, `.card-image`, `.button-tertiary`; background on `.button-primary`. 5.2:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-primary-light
tokens.usage: Used as shadow/glow on `.form-input:focus, .form-select:focus, .form-texta`; background on `.button-tertiary:hover`.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.stat-change.positive`. 2.5:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-warning
tokens.usage: Warning state; pair with a label or icon.

tokens.name: color-error
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.stat-change.negative`. 3.8:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.
